fields.statement: The SQL Server Provider Package's Debug|AnyCPU build configuration sets Optimize to true and its Release|AnyCPU build configuration sets Optimize to false. This holds as written in the project file and is recorded as observed fact, not as an intended convention.
fields.scope: The two configuration-conditioned PropertyGroup elements in ArgentSea.Sql.csproj (Condition "$(Configuration)|$(Platform)"=="Debug|AnyCPU" and =="Release|AnyCPU").
